sentences.text:
Sonu Alam @ Md. Guljar S/o Md. Aiyyub @ Ayyoob Alam R/o vill - Deoria,
 ward no. 6, P.S. - Araria, Distt. - Araria

Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Md Naushaduzzoha, Advocate
For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Zainul Abedin, A.P.P.

For the Informant : Mr. Ramesh Kumar Singh, Advocate  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 3 10-01-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, informant and the State.

2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341,
323, 376, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 67, 67(A) of the Information Technology Act.
3. As per prosecution case, on the alleged date and time of occurrence, this petitioner, on the point of knife, committed rape with minor daughter of the informant.
4. Considering the nature of accusation and gravity of the offence, prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is refused.

(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J) Navya/-
